open_findings.title: Coalesced genre request bypasses the callers session epoch validation
open_findings.preconditions: A valid current listener session has an active genre estimate; another still correctly signed/unexpired cookie for the same account has a revoked epoch. No cross-account forgery is involved.
reproduction: Create actual UserHub around onboarded HubCore with imported profile and hold optional AI promise.
Call estimateGenres(currentEpoch-1) before provider resolves: it returns same promise without running session(epoch).
Release usable provider response: stale RPC returns ok:true and private genre result.
Repeat through actual Worker.fetch POST/api/profile/genres, x-ts:1 and correctly signed test cookie whose epoch is currentEpoch-1: HTTP200 with current profile estimate/summary instead of401.
open_findings.expected: Every caller validates its own session epoch even when joining an active flight, and revoked-session requests cannot read current private result. Keep optional provider await outside playback lock.
open_findings.actual: RPC ok:true; HTTP200 JSON contains current estimate {source:workers-ai,genres:[{name:Pop,share:100}],summary:Sensitive taste}.
open_findings.cause: genreFlight is checked/returned before session(epoch); only first caller supplies epoch used for prepare/store gates.
open_findings.impact: Account logout/revocation contract is bypassed for a previously revoked session while another current session has an active genre estimate. This is a material auth/privacy regression, not an unauthenticated route or cross-account-ID bypass.
open_findings.repair_direction: Validate each caller independently before joining scoped flight, retain coalescing and result/store fencing, and ensure old epoch cannot reuse a new epoch flight.
required_tests: Current and revoked signed cookie concurrent POSTs must produce200/401 respectively.
Valid concurrent requests still share exactly1provider call.
Pause remains unblocked during provider await.
Logout/new epoch and delayed provider result tests retain authorization/store fencing.
